recipes.name: Broccoli & chickpeas Grain Bowl
recipes.description: A simple, flexible recipe for an ordinary day. Choose the ingredients that work for you.
instructions: Use cooked quinoa and cooked protein; wash and chop the vegetables.
Warm the quinoa and protein in a skillet with olive oil. If using chicken or salmon, use fully cooked leftovers and reheat to 74°C / 165°F.
For cucumber or tomato, add raw at serving. For other vegetables, steam or sauté until tender.
Arrange the grain, protein, and vegetables in a bowl and finish with lemon juice.

recipes.name: Broccoli Lentil Soup
recipes.description: A simple, flexible recipe for an ordinary day. Choose the ingredients that work for you.
instructions: Wash and chop vegetables and onion; mince garlic.
Heat oil in a saucepan. Soften the onion for 4 minutes, then add garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the vegetables, cooked lentils, and water. Bring to a simmer.
Cook gently for 15 minutes until the vegetables are tender. For cucumber, add it at the end instead. Season to taste.

recipes.name: Broccoli Wholegrain Wrap
recipes.description: A simple, flexible recipe for an ordinary day. Choose the ingredients that work for you.
instructions: Wash and thinly slice vegetables. Steam potato, sweet potato, broccoli, or cauliflower until tender before filling.
Spread hummus over a wholegrain tortilla.
Add spinach, cooked chickpeas, and vegetables. Fold the sides inward and roll tightly.
Slice in half and serve; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
